verdicts.decision_note: The client confirms the VBUS-to-VMID path and identifies the expected separate VMID and VSYS topology.
The client explicitly defines the battery input range and AXP2101 as the normal system power path.
The client explicitly requires simultaneous battery charging and device operation for the integrated board.
The client explicitly requires AXP-based operation without a connected battery and cites the AXP specifications.

execution.observed_behavior: Battery-only operation succeeded on both boards, but operation from 5V USB caused the 3.3V rail to collapse under load and hard-reset the ESP32, preventing standalone USB operation.

verdicts.decision_note: First concrete runtime result: battery operation succeeds, but the required USB-powered path fails; partial battery-path success does not verify the whole Requirement.
